purpose: Official planning, conservation, local-land-search and highway-search sources for batch 12 candidates. Candidate-specific conclusions remain limited to records directly read back.

sources.coverage: candidate-specific planning record for Countrywide Bearley Mill, Snitterfield Road, application 24/00166/VARY and original permission 21/00973/OUT
sources.binding_limit: The application page verifies the site identity, decision and relationship to the 24-unit residential phase. It does not by itself prove that every marketed acre or all advertised commercial floor area is inside the approved red line, nor does it establish ownership or implementation status.

sources.coverage: CON29 planning, enforcement, environmental, road, rights-of-way, compulsory-purchase and statutory-notice information for property transactions
sources.binding_limit: The council requires a property address and a site plan outlined in red. LLC1 data is obtained from HM Land Registry, while CON29 remains with the council. No Wood Street or Bearley Mill transactional conclusion is published until a completed search is obtained.

sources.coverage: official conservation-area designations, boundary maps, appraisals and special planning-control guidance across Stratford-on-Avon district
sources.binding_limit: The service explains district-wide conservation controls. Exact inclusion of 17 Wood Street and any associated constraints must be confirmed against the current boundary map and property-specific planning or land-charge search.

sources.coverage: planning applications, property planning history, listed-building, conservation-area, Article 4 and environmental status checks in Warwick district
sources.binding_limit: The portal supports address and map queries but no exact Athena Court or Campriano amenity-land property record has been joined in this batch. It cannot establish title extent, auction-lot identity or sale authority.

sources.coverage: property-specific highway status, schemes, notices, compulsory purchase, public paths, byways, common land and highway extent enquiries
sources.binding_limit: A property-specific application and plan are required. The service can clarify Campriano Drive access and highway extent but does not prove ownership, planning permission, services or exact auction-lot title boundaries.
